behaviors.statement: Fork counting and tier suggestion: if/elif, conditional expressions, except handlers, raise, assert and returns before the last statement are forks; lazy-initialization guards, comprehension filters and nested functions are not; full needs over FULL_MIN_LINES body lines and FULL_MIN_FORKS forks, brief needs no forks
behaviors.rationale: A pure function of the parsed source; pytest pins each rule

behaviors.statement: Layout naming and format flags: each docstring is named none, blank, full, compact, placeholder?, brief or prose, and flagged for long lines (against the given limit, line endings excluded), single backticks, citations, section order, unknown labels, misalignment, blank text and stray separator lines; report filters by name or qualname
behaviors.rationale: A pure function of the docstring source lines; pytest pins each flag and layout

behaviors.statement: docstring_tiers.py <file> [<symbol> ...] prints one row per function from the file's own project config; an unknown symbol, a missing file or a syntax error is one problem line and exit 1, never a traceback; nothing is written under the plugin
behaviors.rationale: Command output and exit code on a fixed project; pytest observes them

behaviors.statement: docstrings.line_length is a config key: default 110, an override replaces it, a non-positive or non-integer value and an unknown docstrings key fail config load
behaviors.rationale: Config load behavior; pytest observes the loaded value and the ConfigError

behaviors.statement: The SKILL.md runs the tier command through hpy, reads the convention at ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/docstring_format.md, names every flag and the full-tier threshold, and lists the compact labels in the models' section order, as does the reference
behaviors.rationale: Text facts of the skill and reference files a contract test pins against the models

behaviors.statement: A restyle leaves a symbol without a docstring undocumented unless the developer asks for new docstrings, and names those symbols so the developer can ask
behaviors.rationale: Whether a request covers undocumented symbols is a reading of intent; no file state decides it
